title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1992-03-17
source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Baker, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns > Sony WM-D6; Set 1 Tape:Maxel MX-S 90, Set 2 Tape:TDK MA-110; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion/Flacked With AudioGate Software To 24/96 kHz; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording that captures a joyous St. Patrick’s Day show with standout performances of Box of Rain, Spoonful and The Weight.
ai_review.review: The tape is an AUD that puts the listener right in the crowd, delivering clear ambience and well‑timed crowd yelps.  Musically the band is on a high‑water mark – Phil’s bass shines on Box of Rain, the group rides a playful Spoonful into a heartfelt rendition of The Weight, and the overall vibe is pure fun.

ai_rating.rationale: Detailed five‑star review praises both performance and recording; a second one‑star (0) rating adds uncertainty, so the overall score is high but not maximal.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Immersive audience tape with clear crowd ambience, well‑balanced levels and a nicely timed, not‑too‑loud YELP; no major dropouts mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A festive, sing‑along heavy set that moves smoothly from Box of Rain into Spoonful and finishes with a heartfelt The Weight; the band’s interaction with the crowd feels especially warm for St. Patrick’s Day.

band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for his big‑hearted playing, highlighted on Box of Rain and throughout to Spoonful and The Weight.
